purpose: Make temporal/LOD/aliasing review evidence prove that every authoritative prepared temporal frame used one invariant physical lighting state and the same filmic HDR-source to LDR-destination display transform as intended for native 4K review. This contract is provenance only and never awards visual points.
hardFailIf: the physical lighting SHA-256 differs before any guarded MainCamera temporal cull
the number of guarded MainCamera pre-cull checks is not exactly the number of required temporal frames
the filmic image effect invocation count differs from the required temporal frame count
the HDR-source invocation count differs from the required temporal frame count
the LDR-destination invocation count differs from the required temporal frame count
any temporal native-4K frame uses the filmic fallback blit
the persisted scene, temporal manifest/receipt/prepared binding, or reflection completion/wait proofs no longer match their sealed SHA-256 values
the temporal runtime receipt claims automatic visual points or Visual Fidelity PASS
